The [[Demagogue]] is a [[White Mantle]] champion that leads a massive strike on [[Shining Blade]] camps after [[Markis|a traitor]] gives away their locations throughout the Maguuma Jungle. He can be fought during the [[Aurora Glade]] mission, where he is seen attempting to attune the [[Henge Portal]] for the White Mantle's own benefit.
